content.text:
Found 3 concrete issues:

1. **incomplete_integration_with_existing_code** — writer profile is ignored by Ask Editor and Rubric paths.

   - [comments-panel.tsx:337](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/components/comments/comments-panel.tsx:337) and [comments-panel.tsx:372](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/components/comments/comments-panel.tsx:372) build requests without `writerProfile`.
   - [rubric-panel.tsx:171](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/components/rubric/rubric-panel.tsx:171) and [rubric-panel.tsx:201](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/components/rubric/rubric-panel.tsx:201) do the same.
   - `RubricReviewRequest` also has no profile field at [ai-client.ts:920](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/utils/ai-client.ts:920).

   Consequently, the new Settings profile affects convening/persona-panel flows but not Ask Editor, rubric judges, or full rubric review.

2. **incomplete_integration_with_existing_code** — the feature-specific model filter is defeated for voice features.

   [settings/index.tsx:207-216](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/routes/settings/index.tsx:207) first filters catalog models by modality, then appends every model from `providerModelOptions(provider)`. The result is used for voice selectors at [settings/index.tsx:1856](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/routes/settings/index.tsx:1856).

   A chat-only OpenAI-compatible provider can therefore expose language models in “Voice Narration”; selecting one is persisted and later sent to `/audio/speech` at [ai-client.ts:457](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/utils/ai-client.ts:457), where it will fail.

3. **repetitive_or_duplicate_code** — the new `WriterProfile` default is duplicated instead of using the canonical helper.

   [settings/index.tsx:271-276](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/routes/settings/index.tsx:271) and [personas-panel.tsx:320-325](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/components/personas/personas-panel.tsx:320) both repeat:

   ```ts
   {
     displayName: "",
     personalFacts: "",
     feedbackStyle: "balanced",
     feedbackNotes: "",
   }
   ```

   `DEFAULT_WRITER_PROFILE` already exists at [types/index.ts:632](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/types/index.ts:632), so these copies can silently diverge.

Typecheck and 66 targeted tests pass. I found no additional concrete naming, abstraction-boundary, or refactoring findings.
